nodes.label: Bass EQ Route
nodes.rationale: Routes the clean 80Hz lowshelf and 170Hz mud-cut design to settings, Web Audio fallback, native sync, and MPV filter code.

nodes.label: Clean Bass EQ Route
nodes.rationale: Routes the anti-artifact bass redesign: real 80Hz dB shelf, 170Hz mud control, and no saturation.

nodes.label: Loudness Strength Preset Route
nodes.rationale: Maps user-facing loudness labels to the MPV dynaudnorm parameter semantics and routes the task to the audio-effect entry points.

nodes.label: Audio Effect Validation Handoff
nodes.rationale: Bundled MPV filter loading and FFmpeg RMS checks validate the new graph and preset ordering without compiling the application.

nodes.label: Bass Exciter Parity Handoff
nodes.rationale: The previous MPV implementation lacked the Electron parallel tanh harmonic branch; the fallback Web Audio graph must keep the same branch.

nodes.label: Clean Bass EQ Correction Handoff
nodes.rationale: The user-reported fake bass prompted replacement of broad shelf and saturation with a narrow shelf and low-mid mud cut.

nodes.label: Dynaudnorm Parameter Direction Correction
nodes.rationale: The old g and s comments reversed their official meaning and made loudness presets sound inconsistent with their labels.

nodes.label: Electron Bass Exciter Parity
nodes.rationale: The MPV lowshelf path is paired with a lowpass, tanh soft clip, highpass, and wet mix to match the Electron Web Audio exciter.

nodes.label: Clean Bass EQ Flow
nodes.rationale: The current bass path uses an 80Hz lowshelf for gain and a light 170Hz cut to avoid broad low-mid mud.

nodes.label: Dynaudnorm Strength Semantics
nodes.rationale: FFmpeg g is Gaussian smoothing, m is max gain, and r targets RMS; s=0 preserves local dynamics so gentle, standard, and strong remain ordered.

nodes.label: Phase Sensitive Bass Avoidance
nodes.rationale: Parallel lowpass and dry paths can cancel intended bass gain through filter phase and are intentionally avoided.
